description: Defines classes and interfaces for dynamic baseband gateway buffers using tensor storage, including reader and writer implementations, and buffer resizing functionality.

classes.name: baseband_gateway_buffer_reader_tensor
classes.description: Implements a tensor-based reader for baseband gateway buffers.

classes.name: baseband_gateway_buffer_writer_tensor
classes.description: Implements a tensor-based writer for baseband gateway buffers.

classes.name: baseband_gateway_buffer_dynamic
classes.description: A dynamically resizable buffer for baseband gateway data with fixed channel count.

methods.name: get_nof_channels
methods.description: Returns the number of channels in the buffer.

methods.name: get_nof_samples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples per channel.

methods.name: get_channel_buffer
methods.description: Returns a view of the buffer for a specific channel.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to a new number of samples.
